entries.headline: Coded broadcasts and command aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported two coded U.S. Air Force radio broadcasts during the preceding hour, with multiple transport aircraft and a nuclear command aircraft airborne over the United States.

entries.headline: FORTRESS America initiative report relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a report from @TruthSeekr60 that an initiative called FORTRESS America would move major military installations toward independent power generation. The visible post was truncated after that point.

entries.headline: EAM header WEAB5Y reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported an Emergency Action Message header or preamble carrying the code WEAB5Y.

entries.headline: Jordanian airstrike report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a Liveuamap report that the Jordanian Air Force targeted groups in southern Syria described as linked to the Karak church attack, adding that two outlets had confirmed it. The visible quotation was truncated after that point.

entries.headline: AF2 C-32A sighting over Wyoming reported
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a sighting of Boeing C-32A AF2, registration 98-0002 and hex ADFEB6, over Wyoming. The sighting was credited to truthseekr60.

entries.headline: U.S. surveillance and Baltic air activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported U.S. Air Force surveillance and transport aircraft airborne over the continental United States, with Baltic-region air activity at nearly three times its normal level.

entries.headline: Elevated U.S. and Baltic military air activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported unusually active U.S. Air Force transport aircraft over the continental United States and military air traffic in the Baltic region at nearly three times its normal level.

entries.headline: Ukrainian–Moldovan agreement report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a Suspilne report that representatives of the Ukrainian and Moldovan governments signed an agreement on military-technical matters, adding that two outlets had confirmed it. The visible quotation was truncated after that point.

entries.headline: RCH344 C-17A departure reported
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a sighting of Boeing C-17A Globemaster III RCH344, registration 06-6157 and hex AE145B, departing Diego Garcia. The sighting was credited to truthseekr60.

entries.headline: U.S. transports and command aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported five U.S. Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the continental United States alongside a nuclear command-and-control aircraft, with no coded radio broadcasts heard during the preceding hour.

entries.headline: E-4B departure from Dayton reported
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a sighting of Boeing 747 E-4B aircraft 74-0787, hex ADFEB5, departing Dayton. The sighting was credited to truthseekr60.

entries.headline: NATO09 E-3A Sentry sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a sighting of Boeing E-3A Sentry NATO09, registration LX-N90444 and hex 4D03C2. The sighting was credited to TruthSeekr60.

skyglass.caption: Military aircraft movement reports.

entries.headline: BACE week business-jet totals reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 1,040 distinct business jets in the Las Vegas valley during BACE2026 week, with activity peaking at 306 on Thursday before falling 19% on Friday. It shared a reel covering six days of after-action reports.

entries.headline: BACE departure-heavy traffic reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 309 departures and 154 arrivals on its Las Vegas valley counter by 2:30 p.m. ET as BACE2026 wrapped Friday, saying there were about two departures for every arrival. It shared a 60-times-speed replay.

entries.headline: BACE Friday business-jet activity comparison posted
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported business-jet activity down 19% Friday compared with Thursday as BACE2026 wrapped and shared a whole-day scan.

entries.headline: BACE business-jet arrivals and impact estimated
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 935 business-jet arrivals, 52% above a normal October week, and estimated that they represented about $13.5 million of BACE2026's roughly $50 million Las Vegas impact.

entries.headline: BACE departure surge reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 259 departures from four Las Vegas-area fields by 1:43 p.m. ET, compared with 116 arrivals, and shared a time-lapse covering 10:17 a.m. to 1:29 p.m. ET.

entries.headline: BACE departure and arrival counts shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 120 departures and 48 arrivals across four Las Vegas fields by 12:15 p.m. ET on Thursday during BACE2026, and shared a 30-times-speed replay.

entries.headline: BACE Thursday traffic comparison posted
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported business-jet activity up 10% while overall Las Vegas valley traffic fell 3% on Thursday compared with Wednesday, and shared a whole-day scan.

entries.headline: Las Vegas field departure count reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 243 aircraft still on the ground across four Las Vegas fields at 10:16 a.m. ET Friday, with 61 already departed.

entries.headline: NBAA-BACE peak-hour replay shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a 30-times-speed replay covering 28 minutes of Wednesday’s NBAA-BACE peak traffic across Harry Reid, Henderson, North Las Vegas and Boulder City, followed by a valley-wide view.

entries.headline: N871CB Boulder City arrival replay shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared the Wednesday NBAA-BACE arrival of Citation CJ2 N871CB into Boulder City, showing the approach at ten-times speed and the touchdown in real time.

entries.headline: Henderson NBAA-BACE business-jet traffic reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 81 business jets at Henderson on Wednesday during NBAA-BACE, compared with 172 at Harry Reid, highlighting overflow traffic handled by the valley’s reliever airfields.

entries.headline: Las Vegas NBAA-BACE traffic comparison posted
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported Las Vegas business-jet activity up 13% on Wednesday during NBAA-BACE while overall traffic eased by about 5%, citing SkyGlass MCP data.
